lines.text: The turn is here, and {leader} reaches it in front, with {trailer} close enough to hear every footstep.
Halfway through the Showdown, and nothing is settled, nothing at all!
The halfway flag flashes by, and {leader} carries a lead of {margin} through it!
We have reached the middle, and {trailer} still has everything to play for.
Season {season} of {seasons} is done, and this rivalry is only now finding its voice!
{leader} rounds the midpoint in front, but there is a long road yet, and {trailer} knows every bend of it.
Look at what {winnerClub} and {loserClub} have built, and look at how much road is left!
The first chapter is closed, and the second begins with {trailer} refusing to blink.
Up at the top sits {leader}, and the footsteps behind keep getting louder.
Halfway, and the whole thing is still up for grabs. Settle in, everybody!
The first climb is over, {leader} stands highest on it, and the mountain goes on.
Middle of the Showdown, and both {winnerClub} and {loserClub} know the second half is the one that gets remembered.
The interval whistle sounds, and {trailer} heads for the tunnel with unfinished business.
{leader} leads by {margin} at the halfway mark, and {trailer} has plenty of road left to close it!
Two managers, one long road, and the halfway sign has just flashed past!
Here is the watershed of the Showdown, and everything from here runs downhill toward a champion.
Half the seasons are gone, half remain, and {trailer} has not said the last word.
Same race, same road, and {leader} gets to the midpoint with a spring in the step!
You can feel the weight of it now, {trailer}. The second half is coming, and it belongs to nobody yet.
The halfway marker, and {leader} is first to touch it by {margin}!
A hinge in the Showdown, and {winnerClub} and {loserClub} are standing right on it.
If you thought this was a warm-up, think again, because the halfway mark has arrived!
{trailer} has a whole stretch of seasons to rewrite the story, and {leader} knows it.
Season {season} turns the page, and the story is nowhere near finished!
That is the halfway bell, and the real contest starts right now!
Clear skies at the midpoint, {leader} out in front, and a long, open road for the chase.
Both consoles are warm, both managers hungry, and the Showdown has only just reached its heart!
{leader} by {margin} at the break, and the second half will be played for every inch of it!
Pause for breath, because the Showdown has reached the halfway point and it has barely started!
The rivalry stands {margin} apart at the midpoint, with {leader} in front, and the road ahead can change all of it.
The cabinet has room, the road has length, and {winnerClub} and {loserClub} stand in the middle of it all!
Halfway house for {leader}, and somebody is already knocking at the door.
Not a final, not an ending, only the halfway line, and what a rivalry we have!
This is where Showdowns are won and lost, in the long middle, and {trailer} is still very much here.
{leader} may be ahead at the midpoint, but {trailer} has a way of turning a quiet season into a loud one.
Right in the center of the road, and nobody is looking for the exits!
At the halfway point, {winnerClub} and {loserClub} are going nowhere, and neither is the tension!
Take a good look at where we are, because the run home will not wait for anyone.
The bridge is crossed, season {season} is behind us, and the far bank is a long way off.
Halfway there, and {trailer} has seen enough to believe the second half is theirs.
What a first half it has been between these two, and the second is still a blank page!
{leader} holds the high ground at the midpoint, and the climb goes on for the chaser.
We are at the heart of the Showdown, where the pressure sits heavy and the smiles get thinner!
Half the road behind them, half still ahead, and neither manager has taken a step back.
The compass at the midpoint points to {leader}, but compasses have been known to swing.
A lead of {margin} for {leader} is something at the halfway mark, but it is not everything.
Look at {leader}, strolling into the back half like they own the place!
Under the lights of the middle season, {winnerClub} and {loserClub} wait for what comes next.
There is no hiding place at the halfway mark, and {trailer} would not look for one.
It is a long haul, and here is the milestone: the middle of {seasons} seasons, passed!
Rest if you like, {leader}, but {trailer} has not stopped moving.
The Showdown has turned its corner, and what a view it offers from here!
Somewhere in the second half is a champion, and {trailer} fully intends to be one.
Hold on to your seats, because the halfway point is only the start of the hard part!
The golden hour of the Showdown has arrived, and the second half will be remembered long after the first.
Not a word wasted at the midpoint, just {leader} getting ready for whatever comes next.
The tide has turned at the halfway mark, and nobody on the shore can say which way it runs.
A meeting at the midway point for {winnerClub} and {loserClub}, with the best of the road still ahead!
Strap in, because the middle of a Showdown is where reputations get made.
{trailer} knows the second half is long, and {leader} knows how quickly long can turn short.
Listen to that quiet in the dugout, {trailer}. It is the sound of a second half being planned.
A lap of the track behind us, another to go, and {leader} has the inside line!
Something has to give in the second half, and neither {winnerClub} nor {loserClub} plans to flinch first.
The lights are on, the cup is empty, and the middle of the Showdown is where it starts to fill!
Past the halfway post, and {leader} can hear the footsteps getting louder behind!
Settle the nerves, {leader}. {trailer} certainly has.
It has been a fine first half, and the second may be finer still!
They could not have scripted a better midpoint, and nobody knows how it ends!
The long season keeps rolling on, and at the midpoint {leader} has the better view.
Plenty of road, plenty of time, and {trailer} has a plan up the sleeve.
The ribbons are not tied yet, and the halfway mark says there is a lot of tying left to do!
Somewhere out there is an open-top bus, and the halfway mark says it is still a long drive away!
A sharp breath at the halfway point, and then off they go again, with {trailer} setting the pace.
This could still go anywhere, and that is the best thing about the middle!
{leader} can look back with pride and forward with caution, because {trailer} is right there.
The midpoint brings its own kind of quiet, and then {trailer} comes charging out of it!
Mark this spot, because the tale of this Showdown will bend around it.
Smart money says it is close, wise money says it is open, and {winnerClub} and {loserClub} say nothing at all!
A fine first half, a better second half to come, and the whole rivalry is leaning in!
The leader sets the pace, {trailer} sets the problem, and the next stretch sets the stage!
There is as much Showdown ahead as behind, and {trailer} likes the sound of that.
Silence in the console room, a long breath, and then the second half begins!
They have reached the plateau, the midpoint, and every step after it will be watched twice as closely!
{winnerClub} and {loserClub} have given us a first half for the ages, and we still have the second!
Rivals at the halfway mark, friends at the final whistle, and plenty of football in the middle!
Sit back and enjoy it, folks, because {leader} versus {trailer} is nowhere near done.
You do not reach the halfway mark without a few scars, {trailer}, and you do not stop either.
A gap of {margin} at the midpoint, and {trailer} will be eyeing it all through the second half!
For {leader}, the halfway mark brings a smile. For {trailer}, it brings a plan.
The road bends here, the light changes, and the Showdown steps into its second half!
What a place to stand, right in the middle of a great rivalry!
Hearts in mouths, fingers on the buttons, and the halfway mark just behind us!
{leader} leads, {trailer} lurks, and the second half arrives like a held breath let go!
The middle of the Showdown is never loud, but it is always loaded.
A gap, two managers, and a second half that could swing any which way!
It is the halfway mark, and the story so far is a good one, with {trailer} still to write the next page.
The midpoint arrives, and {leader} meets it eye to eye, without a blink!
Midpoint reached, {margin} on the board, and the second half waiting like a door left ajar!
Between the first whistle and the last, this is the moment the Showdown takes a deep breath.
Halfway up the staircase, {leader} on the higher step and the chase still climbing behind!
